label: PF Backlog 532
title: RCCA: AI grooming never captures the agent proposal (wrong path) + output truncation -> silent deterministic fallback
body:
## Problem AI grooming runs the model but its proposal is discarded, so every AI groom silently falls back to deterministic. Observed: the analyst/groom agent ran on mimo-v2.5 (32k-char prompt), wrote products/

/artifacts/groom/analyst-output.md, and the first call hit the output cap (output_tokens=6000, finish_reason=length). core/grooming._run_ai / _run_ai_batch instead wait for products/

/engineering/groom-.json, which is never created, so they return None. ## Root cause (5-Why) 1. AI groom falls back to deterministic. 2. _run_ai finds no engineering/groom-.json. 3. PipelineExecutor.execute_agent never writes there; it captures the agent answer as artifacts//-output.md. 4. The grooming prompt assumes file-write capability the agent runtime does not invoke. 5. No test asserts the AI path yields a proposal, and the fallback is silent, so the defect was invisible. ## Fix - Read the proposal from the agent execution artifact (execution.artifacts / analyst-output.md), not a magic file; strip the framework header, then parse JSON robustly (fenced or bare). - Batch: request ONE compact JSON object keyed by item id (no prose, no files) to fit the output budget. - Surface ai_failed (no silent fallback): record when the AI path returned nothing usable. - Stubbed test for the capture/parse path (no live model) so this cannot regress. ## In scope - capture agent output + JSON parse in core/grooming.py (_run_ai, _run_ai_batch, helpers) - batch prompt switched to a single id-keyed JSON object - stubbed tests ## Out of scope - replacing the agent runtime with a direct LLM client - changing model/provider selection ## Acceptance - AI groom uses the produced artifact and stores a proposal (mode=ai) when the agent returns JSON. - A missing/garbled proposal falls back to deterministic AND is surfaced (not silent). - Stubbed tests pass without a live model.

brief.problem: AI groom runs the full pipeline agent flow but its proposal was discarded (wrong path) and multi-item output truncated, so it silently fell back to deterministic.
brief.what_adds: Groom via the single LLM owner directly (one-shot LLMClient call, no agent runtime); robust JSON parse; compact id-keyed batch prompt; surface ai_failed.

objective: Make AI grooming capture and store the agent's JSON proposal from the execution artifact, with a non-silent deterministic fallback, so AI groom actually works.
acceptance_criteria: _run_ai / _run_ai_batch read the agent artifact (analyst-output.md) and parse the JSON proposal.
batch prompt requests one compact JSON object keyed by item id; result split per item.
AI failure is surfaced (ai_failed) instead of a silent deterministic fallback.
New stubbed test covers capture + parse without a live model.
in_scope: capture agent output artifact + JSON parse
approach: capture agent output + JSON parse in core/grooming.py (_run_ai, _run_ai_batch, helpers); batch prompt switched to a single id-keyed JSON object; stubbed tests
verification: AI groom uses the produced artifact and stores a proposal (mode=ai) when the agent returns JSON.
A missing/garbled proposal falls back to deterministic AND is surfaced (not silent).
Stubbed tests pass without a live model.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_hierarchy.py, core/agent_ledger.py

api_impact.reason: No new API; existing groom/groom-all behavior fixed.

rationale: Root fix: call the LLM client directly instead of execute_agent; parse JSON from the response.
